item.headline: US government accelerates domestic critical minerals mining via expedited permitting and federal investment stakes
causal_chain: Federal permitting timeline compressed from ~10 years to 28 days and government taking direct equity stakes in domestic mining operations to counter China's 100% control of 15 critical mineral supply chains

Accelerated permitting lowers the primary risk discount (regulatory duration uncertainty) embedded in junior and mid-cap mining equities; government co-investment reduces capital cost and offtake risk for named names (MP Materials rare earths, Lithium Americas, Trilogy Metals)

Structural domestic supply chain de-risking reduces long-run import dependence for defense, EV, and semiconductor sectors — a multi-year thematic tailwind, but near-term price action depends on whether this reflects new policy action or re-promotion of previously announced measures
item.directional_bias: bullish domestic critical minerals miners; MOS neutral (different commodity, tangential beneficiary)

sizing_recommendation.rationale: Source is a GlobeNewswire press release (promotional distribution channel), the $100T figure is speculative framing, and the permitting timeline claim lacks a named legislative or executive action — confidence is capped at 0.4 by low_specificity flag; stand down until a primary-source policy announcement confirms

item.headline: U.S. push to win drone race faces big obstacle: China owns supply chain
causal_chain: U.S. domestic drone programs are constrained by Chinese dominance of critical component supply chains (motors, ESCs, sensors, LiPo cells), creating a structural reshoring imperative
Policy pressure and defense procurement rules (e.g., NDAA Section 848 restrictions on Chinese-origin drones) accelerate demand for domestically-sourced drone platforms and components

Pure-play U.S. defense drone manufacturers (KTOS, AVAV) and defense-aerospace ETFs (ITA) benefit from redirected procurement spend; Chinese-linked drone firms face further exclusion from U.S. contracts
item.directional_bias: bullish domestic U.S. defense drone / aerospace names; bearish Chinese-supply-dependent drone vendors in U.S. government markets

sizing_recommendation.rationale: Thematic Layer 0/sector signal only — no confirmed procurement event, no specific ticker in portfolio affected, and causal chain is policy-trend rather than a discrete catalyst; insufficient specificity for probe entry
